user.title: Set up TV guide
user.description: Downloads programme data in XMLTV format once a day. The default is the German file from iptv-epg.org (about 45 MB). Choose which channels are kept under “Configure” afterwards.

error.ungueltige_adresse: The address must start with http:// or https://.

init.title: Channels
init.description: Only these channels are kept and queried. The list fills after the first download.

abfragen.name: Query guide
abfragen.description: What is on now or at a given time (current and next show per channel), or when a show airs (search).

zeitpunkt.name: Time
zeitpunkt.description: Time (20:15) or date and time (2026-10-26T20:15); empty = now.

sender.name: Channels
sender.description: Only these channels; empty = all selected.

suche.name: Search
suche.description: Title or part of it; returns the next airings.
